# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `sst docs` from the engine's registries. Edit the registries, not this file. -->

`sst_config.yml` (or `sst_config.yaml`, but not both) sits at the project root;
`--config` or `$SST_CONFIG` names another file instead. Every key SST reads is
listed here, and nothing else is read:

- an unknown key is a warning (`SST-CFG003`), or an error when it is a
  misspelled top-level block (`SST-CFG007`);
- a removed key is an error that says what replaced it.

Keys that start with `+` set a default that nested folder routes inherit; an
artifact overrides one in its own `config:` block, writing the key without
its `+`. An absent key inherits, and a `+` key written with
no value is an error (`SST-CFG054`). In a key path, `<route>` stands for a
folder name and `<name>` for any entry of a name map.

## project

Where each artifact type lives on disk.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project.semantic_models_dir` | string | `semantic_models` | Semantic view YAML. dbt projects only. |
| `project.agents_dir` | string | `agents` | Agent specs; per-agent evals nest under each agent. |
| `project.eval_metrics_dir` | string | `eval_metrics` | Shared LLM-judge metrics for evals. |
| `project.tools_dir` | string | `tools` | Backing objects for agent tools. |
| `project.skills_dir` | string | `skills` | `SKILL.md` folders, published as Cortex Extensions and inside Desktop profiles. |
| `project.plugins_dir` | string | `plugins` | Plugin manifests, each grouping skills into one extension. |
| `project.profiles_dir` | string | `profiles` | CoCo Desktop profiles plus the shared prompt and rules. |
| `project.cowork_profiles_dir` | string | `cowork_profiles` | Snowflake CoWork profiles (Snowflake private preview), each routing questions to agents. |
| `project.hooks_dir` | string | `hooks` | Hook definitions and their scripts, referenced by profiles. |
| `project.mcp_servers_dir` | string | `mcp-servers` | MCP server configs, referenced by profiles. |
| `project.commands_dir` | string | `commands` | Desktop slash commands (`*.md`, nested folders allowed), referenced by profiles. |
| `project.target_profile` | string |  | The `profiles.yml` profile of a project with no `dbt_project.yml`. In a dbt project it must match the dbt `profile:`. |

## validation

What blocks a build.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `validation.strict` | boolean | `false` | Promote every warning to an error. |
| `validation.snowflake_syntax_check` | boolean | `true` | Compile expressions against Snowflake during validate and plan, and run each allowed orchestration model in a throwaway agent (SST-VAL551 to SST-VAL556). Must be written out, true or false (SST-CFG031). |
| `validation.description_floor` | integer, at least 1 |  | Shortest description, in characters, a semantic view or metric may carry (SST-VAL004); unset checks none. |
| `validation.instruction_budget` | integer, at least 1 |  | Longest composed comment and instructions, in characters, a semantic view may publish (SST-VAL018); unset checks none. |
| `validation.exclude_dirs` | list | `[]` | Globs of project-relative directories discovery skips: no semantic model file under one is read. |

## diagnostics

How severe a diagnostic is, beyond what the error registry declares.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `diagnostics.severity_overrides` | map |  | Per-code severity. A warning may become an error or info, an error a warning, and an info a warning; a non-demotable code is never lowered (SST-CFG033). Strict mode promotes after overrides apply. |
| `diagnostics.severity_overrides.<name>` | enum: `error`, `warning`, `info` |  | The severity this registered code reports at; a code the registry lacks is SST-CFG003. |

## enrichment

What `sst enrich` collects from the warehouse, and how much.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enrichment.distinct_limit` | integer, 1 to 1000 | `25` | Distinct values sampled per column. A column with no more than this many is an enum. |
| `enrichment.sample_values_display_limit` | integer, 1 to 1000 | `10` | Sample values written for a column that is not an enum. At most `distinct_limit`. |
| `enrichment.synonym_model` | string | `claude-sonnet-4-5` | Cortex model that writes synonyms. |
| `enrichment.synonym_max_count` | integer, 1 to 20 | `4` | Synonyms written per column and per table. |
| `enrichment.allow_sample_value_collection` | boolean | `true` | False refuses every run that reads row data, one that includes `sample-values` or `enums` (SST-CFG038). |

## governance

Which Snowflake column tags make a column sensitive, read only when `read_column_tags` is true.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `governance.sensitive_tags` | list | `[]` | Tags that make a column sensitive, each `<database>.<schema>.<tag>`, or `<database>.<schema>.*` for every tag in that schema (SST-CFG057); an unquoted part matches without case. A column carrying one, set on it or inherited, by any apply method, is never sampled and its values reach no prompt. |
| `governance.read_column_tags` | boolean | `false` | Read each relation's column tags (`TAG_REFERENCES_ALL_COLUMNS`) in `sst enrich` and the connected `sst validate`; false reads none, so only `pii_tags` and `meta.sst.governance_tags` mark a column. |

## generation

How the commands that reach Snowflake pace their work.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `generation.threads` | integer, 1 to 16 | `4` | Sessions `plan`, `validate` and `test` work on at once, and changes `apply` applies at once, unless `--threads` or `$SST_THREADS` says. Unset, applying takes `skills.+threads` first, and `test` takes 1. |
| `generation.view_timeout` | integer, at least 1 | `300` | Seconds one statement of a plan or apply session may run (`STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_IN_SECONDS`). |

## dbt

How SST produces and reads the dbt manifest.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dbt.invoke` | boolean | `true` | Run dbt before reading the manifest; false reads the one on disk and checks it against the model files (SST-DBT005). |
| `dbt.command` | enum: `parse`, `compile` | `parse` | The dbt command that writes the manifest; `compile` needs a warehouse. |
| `dbt.manifest_schema_versions` | list | the versions this release is tested against | Manifest schema version numbers read, such as `[12]`. The list replaces the default set rather than adding to it, so name every version to accept; any other is refused (SST-DBT017) unless `--allow-unsupported-manifest-schema` is given. |

## defer

Resolve dbt objects to another target's relations while publishing to `--target`.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `defer.target` | string |  | The `profiles.yml` target relations resolve to; `--defer-target` overrides it. |
| `defer.state_path` | string | `sst_target/defer/<target>` | Directory holding that target's dbt `manifest.json`. |
| `defer.auto_compile` | boolean | `false` | Run dbt for the deferred target to write its manifest under `state_path` (dbt Core only). |

| `tools.+warehouse` | string | the target warehouse | Warehouse for defined search services and procedures. |

| `tools.+embedding_model` | string |  | Embedding model for defined search services. |

## agents

Defaults for Cortex Agents, overridable per folder and by an agent's own `config:`.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agents.+database` | identifier | the target database | Database for agents. |
| `agents.+schema` | identifier | the target schema | Schema for agents. |
| `agents.+warehouse` | string | the target warehouse | Warehouse an agent's Analyst, search, and generic tools run on when they name none. |
| `agents.+orchestration_model` | string | `auto` | Orchestration model; must be in `snowflake.orchestration_models` (SST-CFG025 here, SST-VAL543 for the value an agent resolves). `auto` lets Snowflake choose, and SST-VAL560 warns. |
| `agents.+allow_auto_model` | boolean | `false` | Keep an agent's orchestration model on `auto` deliberately: true silences SST-VAL560 for it, not SST-VAL544. |
| `agents.+query_timeout` | integer, at least 1 |  | Query timeout, in seconds, of an agent's tools that set none. |
| `agents.+budget_seconds` | integer, at least 1 |  | Orchestration time budget, in seconds. |
| `agents.+budget_tokens` | integer, at least 1 |  | Orchestration token budget. |
| `agents.+tool_not_accessible` | enum: `accept`, `reject`, `legacy` |  | Behavior when a tool is not accessible. |
| `agents.+analytical_search` | boolean |  | Enable analytical search. |
| `agents.+alias` | string |  | Version alias assigned after publication. |
| `agents.+enabled` | boolean | `true` | Whether agents are compiled; false leaves them out of the project. |
| `agents.+secure` | boolean | `false` | Publish agents with `SECURE = TRUE`. |
| `agents.+scratch_schema` | two-part name | the agent's own schema | `DATABASE.SCHEMA` where `sst ask` and `sst test --suite evals --unpublished` make their scratch copies and temporary agents, and connected validate its model probes (SST-VAL551), for a role that cannot create them in the agent's own schema, or an agent in a personal database, which cannot hold a semantic view. Nothing publishes there. |
| `agents.+tags` | list |  | Tags, as `name` and `value` entries, set with ALTER AGENT ... SET TAG; a closer setting replaces the list. |
| `agents.<route>` | block |  | Folder route: overrides for agents under that directory. |

## cowork_profiles

Defaults for Snowflake CoWork profiles (Snowflake private preview; https://docs.snowflake.com/en/LIMITEDACCESS/snowflake-cortex/about-cowork-profiles), overridable per folder and by a profile's own `config:`.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cowork_profiles.+database` | identifier | the target database | Database for CoWork profiles; CoWork lists only the profiles in SNOWFLAKE_INTELLIGENCE.PROFILES. |
| `cowork_profiles.+schema` | identifier | the target schema | Schema for CoWork profiles; CoWork lists only the profiles in SNOWFLAKE_INTELLIGENCE.PROFILES. |
| `cowork_profiles.+orchestration_model` | string | `auto` | Orchestration model the profile routes questions with; must be in `snowflake.orchestration_models` (SST-CFG025). `auto` lets Snowflake choose, and SST-VAL560 warns. |
| `cowork_profiles.+allow_auto_model` | boolean | `false` | Keep a profile's orchestration model on `auto` deliberately: true silences SST-VAL560 for it, not SST-VAL544. |
| `cowork_profiles.+alias` | string |  | Version alias assigned after publication. |
| `cowork_profiles.+enabled` | boolean | `true` | Whether CoWork profiles are compiled; false leaves them out of the project. |
| `cowork_profiles.+attach` | boolean | `true` | Attach each profile published to SNOWFLAKE_INTELLIGENCE.PROFILES to the account's CoWork object, and again when it was detached by hand; false leaves it unattached, and never detaches one (Snowflake private preview; https://docs.snowflake.com/en/LIMITEDACCESS/snowflake-cortex/about-cowork-profiles). |
| `cowork_profiles.+tags` | list |  | Tags, as `name` and `value` entries, set with ALTER AGENT ... SET TAG; a closer setting replaces the list. |
| `cowork_profiles.<route>` | block |  | Folder route: overrides for CoWork profiles under that directory. |

## evals

Defaults for agent evaluations, overridable per agent folder and by an eval config's own `config:`.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `evals.+eval_tier` | enum: `blocking`, `report` |  | Whether a regression blocks; unset is `report`. |
| `evals.+metrics` | list |  | System metrics, ungated, of an eval config whose `metrics:` lists no `system`. |
| `evals.+metric_version` | string |  | Version of each system metric that names none; only `v3` is accepted (SST-VAL723), and unset with none named is SST-VAL722. |
| `evals.+judge_model` | string |  | Judge model of each custom metric that names none. |
| `evals.+agent_version` | string |  | Agent version an eval runs against. |
| `evals.+retry` | integer |  | Retries per run; unset retries none. Each attempt is reported. |
| `evals.+concurrency` | integer |  | Eval runs a suite starts and polls at once. At the root it is also the most a folder route or an eval's `config:` may ask (SST-VAL731). |
| `evals.+baseline_runs` | integer |  | Completed attempts a baseline needs; unset needs 1. |
| `evals.+min_dataset_rows` | integer |  | Smallest accepted question set (SST-VAL710); unset checks none. |
| `evals.+candidate_models` | list |  | Orchestration models `sst test --suite evals --compare-models` compares with the pinned one, each from `snowflake.orchestration_models` when that is set (SST-VAL771) and never `auto` (SST-VAL770); `--compare-models <list>` replaces it. |
| `evals.+compare_runs` | integer, at least 1 | `2` | Runs of each model a comparison makes, at least 1; `--compare-runs` replaces it. |
| `evals.+retention` | enum: `audit`, `decision` |  | Retention class recorded with each run; SST never deletes a run on the strength of it. |
| `evals.<route>` | block |  | Folder route under `project.agents_dir`: overrides for the evals of the agents under that directory. |

## skills

Defaults for skills, overridable per folder and by a skill's own `config:`. A skill publishes as a Cortex Extension only when `+bundle_stage` resolves for it.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skills.+database` | identifier | the target database | Database for skill extensions. |
| `skills.+schema` | identifier | the target schema | Schema for skill extensions. |
| `skills.+bundle_stage` | identifier or three-part name |  | Internal stage that `ADD VERSION` reads from; created when absent. Unset, the skill does not publish. |
| `skills.+certified` | boolean | `false` | Tag each new skill version `SNOWFLAKE.CORE.CERTIFICATION_STATUS = 'CERTIFIED'`. |
| `skills.+version_prefix` | string | `SST_` | Prefix of every version alias, and of each profile's VERSION; the rest is 12 hex characters of the digest. |
| `skills.+threads` | integer, 1 to 16, root only | `4` | Changes `apply` applies at once when neither `--threads`, `$SST_THREADS`, nor `generation.threads` says. Profiles always publish one at a time. |
| `skills.<route>` | block |  | Folder route: overrides for the skills under that directory. |

Defaults for CoCo Desktop profiles, overridable per folder and by a profile's own `config:`. A profile publishes only when `+stage` resolves for it.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |

## extensions

Name map for extensions this project consumes but does not publish.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `extensions.default_prefix` | string |  | `<database>.<schema>` for entries without `fqn:`. |

## apply

Stages apply uploads through.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apply.agent_spec_stage` | block |  | Internal stage agent specs are uploaded to. Created when absent, server-side encrypted; an existing stage of another kind blocks the plan. |
| `apply.agent_spec_stage.database` | string | the target database | Stage database. |
| `apply.agent_spec_stage.schema` | string | the target schema | Stage schema. |
| `apply.agent_spec_stage.stage` | string | `AGENT_SPECS` | Stage name. |
| `apply.eval_config_stage` | block |  | Stage for eval run configs, in each agent's schema. |
| `apply.eval_config_stage.stage` | string | `EVAL_CONFIGS` | Stage name. |
| `apply.fail_fast` | boolean | `false` | Stop at the first failure instead of continuing; `--fail-fast` and `--no-fail-fast` override it. |
| `apply.create_schemas` | boolean | `true` | Create each absent schema the plan publishes into, as dbt does, `CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS`, before anything else; false makes an absent schema SST-PLN010. Plan reads nothing in one it creates, so everything published there, skills, profiles and evals among them, plans as a create. Never a database, and never dropped. |

## ask

How `sst ask` keeps and shows a conversation.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ask.transcripts` | boolean | `false` | Keep a transcript of each run in `sst_target/ask/`, every turn whole with each specification it ran on; `--transcript` and `--no-transcript` override it. |
| `ask.theme` | string | `sst-dark` | The full-screen conversation's color theme: `sst-dark` or one of Textual's own; `--theme` and `$SST_ASK_THEME` override it, and an unknown one is SST-ASK011. |

## plan

What plan compares beyond each object's ownership marker.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plan.drift_check` | enum: `full`, `basic` | `full` | Which live properties SST published plan compares with what apply read back, to find an edit that kept the ownership marker (SST-PLN014). `full` also reads each procedure's DESCRIBE and each semantic view's GET_DDL, one query each; `basic` compares only what SHOW and an agent's versions list. |

## snowflake

Allowlists for Snowflake surfaces the renderer accepts.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `snowflake.orchestration_models` | list | `[auto]` | Orchestration models agents may name; the syntax check runs each one in a throwaway agent. |
| `snowflake.tool_types` | list |  | Agent tool types added to the ones SST renders, for a type Snowflake shipped since this release. |
| `snowflake.allow_unknown_keys` | boolean | `true` | Render agent spec keys SST does not model with a warning; false makes each an error. |
| `snowflake.profile` | block |  | Agent profile allowlists. |
| `snowflake.profile.avatar_allowlist` | list |  | Avatars an agent profile may name; unset allows any. |

## Deprecated keys

Each is an error (`SST-CFG200`) naming the key that replaced it.

| Key | Read as |
|---|---|
| `deploy` | `apply` |

## Removed keys

These keys were read by SST 0.3 or an earlier 1.0 draft. Each is an error
now, so a setting that no longer does anything cannot pass review looking
as though it still does.

| Key | Why it was removed | Code |
|---|---|---|
| `validation.expression_rules` | the expression rules it disabled are no longer optional | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `validation.multipath_check` | multi-path relationship analysis is always on | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `validation.smoke_query` | smoke probes run only under sst test --suite smoke | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `generation.publish_via` | SST 1.0 renders DDL directly | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `generation.filters_to_instructions` | standalone filter prose always renders into the view | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `generation.use_create_or_alter` | SST 1.0 renders DDL directly | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `generation.emit_relationship_type` | relationship and join types are never rendered | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `vars.sha_version` | SST supplies sha_version from the commit being published | [`SST-CFG040`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg040) |
| `tools.+enabled` | omit the tools instead | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `semantic_views.+meta` | put metadata on the view itself | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `agents.+copy_grants` | agents are never replaced, so there are no grants to copy | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `agents.+meta` | put metadata on the agent itself | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `agents.+create_mode` | agents are created once and versioned | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `evals.+enabled` | omit the evals instead | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `evals.+database` | eval objects resolve to the agent's schema | [`SST-CFG015`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg015) |
| `evals.+schema` | eval objects resolve to the agent's schema | [`SST-CFG015`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg015) |
| `skills.+grant_read_to` | access is managed outside SST; SST never issues grants | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `skills.+enabled` | a skill publishes only where +bundle_stage resolves for it | [`SST-CFG043`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg043) |
| `skills.catalog` | set +bundle_stage, +database and +schema on skills: and plugins: themselves | [`SST-CFG042`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg042) |
| `skills.stage` | profiles publish through the profiles: block | [`SST-CFG042`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg042) |
| `skills.extensions` | consumed extensions are the top-level extensions: block | [`SST-CFG042`](error-codes.md#sst-cfg042) |
